items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued June 21 at 12:55PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
ESFAFC

Rainfall

* Susitna Valley: Widespread rainfall totaling 1 to 3 inches with
the highest totals likely across the northern and western portions
of the valley.

Hydrologic Concerns

* Expect sharp rises on many small streams and rivers. Many smaller
streams will crest Tuesday night into Wednesday with larger rivers
cresting Wednesday into Thursday such as the Skwentna and Yentna
rivers.

* Many lower locations along rivers such as gravel bars and other
spots popular for camping and recreat
items.areas: Western Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley; Northern Susitna Valley

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued June 21 at 12:29PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

A front is expected to move westward over the state towards the
beginning of this week. As this front progresses, we are expecting
widespread rain showers and thunderstorms to begin Tuesday morning
for the eastern Alaska Range and spread west by Tuesday afternoon
during the time of heaviest rainfall with totals as high as 1" or
more in some locations. Rapid rises of smaller rivers are possible
with the heaviest rain on Tuesday in and near the Alaska Range. We
will continue to keep you up
items.areas: Northern Denali Borough; Southern Denali Borough; Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp; Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued June 21 at 8:39AM AKDT until June 21 at 8:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to the low 80s.

* WHERE...City of Hyder and Haines Borough and Klukwan.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The hottest temperatures will be during the
late afternoon hours and located in areas away from sea breeze
influences.
items.areas: Haines Borough and Klukwan; City of Hyder
items.instruction:

occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 20 at 2:20PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Saturday afternoon hot temperatures continue to impact most of the
Central and Eastern Interior, with high temperatures climbing back
into the 80s. Take caution when participating in outdoor
activities. Stay hydrated and limit strenuous outdoor activity in
the afternoon when temperatures are the highest.
